name: linux-screencast-skills
description: Author and produce narrated screencast tutorials for AI tooling and any developer workflow, on a Linux host. screencast-storyboard scripts a tutorial: it reads the real docs and drafts an approved storyboard (transcript + timeline). screencast-tutorial-video produces the video: it records each scene with the right engine (VHS terminal, ffmpeg still-motion for native apps, headless Playwright for the browser, command cards) and assembles an OpenAI voice-over, captioned 1920x1080 MP4. Works in Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Script and produce narrated, captioned screencast tutorials for AI tooling on Linux
